evaluation: Leave-one-target-out over 5 SPHEREx fields (9-24 frames each), 2,400 test stamps per fold. Scores are from fold models; the shipped model is trained on all 5.
data: Fake changes added to real SPHEREx DR1/QR3 frames; before and after are one frame with fresh fake noise, not two visits. No real movers, no human labels.
selection: Trees retained; the CNN did not pass its comparison checks on these same held-out folds.
limits: Labels change spots only; it does not find planets. Not tested on a real asteroid. Mover recall is 0.45 at S/N 3-5. A quarter of test stamps are movers; if real ones are rarer, more mover labels are wrong.
treesNote: Trees saw 600 stamps per class per target, the CNN 2,500: not like-for-like.
belowGate: Below the 0.85 target: mover recall at S/N>=10 on barnard 0.755, epsindb 0.739, rwaur 0.776, wise0855 0.805; artifact precision on barnard 0.749, epsindb 0.744, rdra 0.803, rwaur 0.766, wise0855 0.738. Below the 0.80 target: macro-F1 on barnard 0.789.
